text:
maria_cs: Hey team — prepping a proposal for Pegasus (on-prem) to reduce cost + meet latency SLOs. Recommended combo: int8 quant on gp2-optimized, model swap from gpt-small-2 -> gp2-opt, and region-aware routing fallback. Their p95 token latency spikes to ~420ms during bursts. Thinking a 2-week pilot with canary A/B routing. Thoughts?

ajay_eng: Sounds reasonable. Quick q: do we have a validated int8 profile for gp2-optimized on their A10x fleet? If not we should include an fp16 fallback in the rollout policy.

taylor_se: We ran microbench sims last month — int8 yields ~42% cost reduction and adds ~25-35ms variance on p95 depending on KV hit rate. On A10x it's generally stable. Recommend enabling prefix caching + conservative batch sizing (max_batch_size=2) to keep latency SLO.

kevin_pm: From CS side Pegasus agreed to a pilot but wants explicit rollback criteria and quality monitoring. Can we guarantee automated rollback if eval metric degradation >2% on their golden set?

maria_cs: @kevin_pm yes — we'll include rollout gates. @ajay_eng what gating metrics should we enforce from infra side?

ajay_eng: Gate on model perplexity/ROUGE on their eval suite and token-level distribution drift. Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% across 3 days if latency and quality within thresholds. Automatic rollback if p95 increases >15% or eval drop >2%.

deploybot: deploy-bot: Canary test cluster created: canary-pegasus-qpilot-1. Logs forwarded to /logs/pegasus/qpilot/1876543210

taylor_se: Posting suggested canary config snippet:
```
route: canary-pegasus-qpilot
weights:
  gp2-opt-int8: 0.1
  gp2-opt-fp16: 0.9
batching:
  max_batch_size: 2
  max_latency_ms: 80
prefix_cache: true
kv_cache_ttl_ms: 5000
```
I'll tune KV TTL based on observed hit rates.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: I'll draft the customer-facing pilot plan (timeline, rollback triggers, data capture). Can we get an ops on-call review before Monday? @ajay_eng @taylor_se

ajay_eng: Available Friday AM. I'll run stress tests against canary cluster and share Grafana dashboard. Expect to capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and error rates.

taylor_se: I'll add a perf-run script to the repo and include traces for a few worst-case prompts. Quick perf diff from sims: baseline gp2-fp16 p95=420ms, gp2-int8 p95=360ms, median cost down ~42%.

maria_cs: Noted. Participants: Pegasus contact is ops@pegasus.example (external). Next steps: 1) finalize config + commit, 2) internal stress + ops review, 3) send kickoff email + schedule pilot. I'll update this thread when email is out.

kevin_pm: :eyes: tagging renewal lead — this is helpful for renewal conversation, will follow up with results once pilot completes.

maria_cs: Thanks all — moving to action items.
